mapper.sql: ID, COLLECT_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE, PLAN_QTY, STOCK_QTY, SAFE_STOCK_QTY, RESERVE_STOCK_RATE, PRODUCE_QTY,MACHINE_CODE, DATA_SOURCE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, IS_FINISHING, FINAL_GLUE_MACHINE,UP_GLUE,UP_MACHINE_CODE,DAY_FLAG
mapper.select: SELECT p.BATCH_NO AS COLLECT_BATCH_NO, /*汇总胶料计划批次号*/ p.PLAN_DATE, /*计划日期*/ p.MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ p.GLUE, /*胶料号*/ ifnull(p.PRODUCE_QTY,0) PLAN_QTY, /*计划量*/ p.MACHINE_CODE, /*密炼机台编号*/ p.IS_FINISHING, /*收尾计划标识(1-是，准备收尾；0--否)*/ concat(p.glue, '-', p.MACHINE_CODE) finalGlueMachine, p.IS_FINISHING /*收尾计划标识(1-是，准备收尾；0--否)*/ FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN p WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND p.PLAN_DATE = #{planDate} AND p.PRODUCE_QTY > 0 AND p.MIX_AREA=#{mixArea}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_glue_decompose_plan SET DEL_FLAG = '1' WHERE 1=1 AND (PLAN_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE) IN (#{plan.planDate}, #{plan.mixArea}, #{plan.glue})
mapper.select: select * from t_glue_decompose_plan WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (PLAN_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE) IN (#{plan.planDate}, #{plan.mixArea}, #{plan.glue})
